label: Greenhouse
terms_note: Job Board API: public GET boards/<token>/jobs; POST application needs the board's Job Board API key (account-provided). CV: pdf, doc, docx, txt, rtf.

capabilities: apply_submit (employer Job Board API key only)

reference.verdict: **Verdict** — has_api: **partial** (public Job Board API for jobs; apply POST needs the board's secret key).
auth: 1. All GET endpoints are public — no authentication.

2. `POST /v1/boards/{token}/jobs/{id}` (submit an application) requires HTTP Basic with the **Job Board API key** from the company's API Credentials page (user name = key, no password, Base64). The docs call it a secret that must be proxied through the company's own servers — a candidate tool cannot

endpoints.notes: jobs[]: id, internal_job_id, title, updated_at, requisition_id, location.name, absolute_url, metadata, content (HTML), departments[], offices[], data_compliance[]
content, questions[] {required, label, fields[{name,type,values}]} incl. resume_text / resume_content, location_questions, demographic_questions, compliance[], data_compliance

first_name, last_name, email, phone, location, resume_content (base64) + resume_content_filename or resume_text, cover_letter*, question ids (`question_123`), education/employment blocks, data_compliance[gdpr_processing_consent_given

reference.limits: Not published on the Job Board API page. - Job data is public by design ("Job Board data is publicly available"). - Applications through the API are a feature for the company's own careers site (secret key, GDPR consent handling is the company's configuration). From the candidate side apply is the hosted form → assist. Registry `api.apply: true` presumes an employer key.

config_fields.name: board_token
config_fields.help: The company's Greenhouse Job Board URL token, e.g. 'vaulttec' in https://boards.greenhouse.io/vaulttec.

search.note: Job Board API for ONE company's board (config board_token): GET https://boards-api.greenhouse.io/v1/boards/{board_token}/jobs?content=true 'Returns the list of all job posts' — 'Job Board data is publicly available, so authentication is not required for any GET endpoints'. There are no keyword, location or paging parameters, so query/location/page/limit are not sent and every post comes back in one response (total = meta.total): filter client-side and do not request further pages. id is the job post id (use it with get_posting); content is the description as entity-encoded HTML; departments[], offices[], updated_at, application_deadline and metadata are in raw.

get_posting.note: GET /v1/boards/{board_token}/jobs/{job_id} 'Returns a job post'; pay_transparency=true adds pay_input_ranges[] when the employer publishes them. salary_min/salary_max are the FIRST range's min_cents/max_cents — amounts in cents, not units — and further ranges (e.g. per location) are in raw.pay_input_ranges.

not_offered.me: 'authentication is not required for any GET endpoints'; there is no account endpoint to verify.
not_offered.apply: 'Only the application submission endpoint (POST https://boards-api.greenhouse.io/v1/boards/{board_token}/jobs/{id}) requires Basic Auth' with the employer's Job Board API key, and resumes are multipart file uploads; candidates apply at absolute_url.
not_offered.list_messages: No candidate messaging in the Job Board API.
